fields.options: <div class='text-muted small'>Install a free, local AI model (Ollama) once on a shared office PC/server, then every AlphaX CRM user gets AI Assist through it — no data leaves your network to a third-party AI vendor. Pick your server's operating system below to download a ready-to-run setup script: it installs Ollama, lets you choose a model size, and opens a secure tunnel so this site can reach it. When the script finishes it fills in AI Base URL and Model above on its own — nothing to copy or paste. Save this form once, then use Test AI Connection to confirm it works.

fields.description: Optional, for production use once the quick tunnel above has proven the setup works. A quick tunnel (*.trycloudflare.com) is a plain, unauthenticated public URL that changes every restart — fine to get started, not something to leave running long-term. A named Cloudflare Tunnel keeps a fixed address, and putting it behind Cloudflare Access with a Service Token means Cloudflare rejects every request at its edge — before it ever reaches your machine — unless it carries the two secret headers below. No one browsing to the tunnel URL directly can reach your AI server; only this CRM, using these credentials, can.
fields.label: 7.4  Secure Remote Access (Named Tunnel + Cloudflare Access)

fields.options:
One-time setup, on the machine running Ollama and in the Cloudflare dashboard:
  1. Add a domain to Cloudflare (free plan is fine) if you haven't already.
  2. cloudflared tunnel login, then cloudflared tunnel create alphax-ollama.
  3. cloudflared tunnel route dns alphax-ollama ai.yourdomain.com.
  4. Point the tunnel's config at http://localhost:11434 and run it as a service (cloudflared service install) so it survives reboots.
  5. In the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard: Access → Applications → add ai.yourdomain.com, with a policy requiring Service Auth (not a login page — this CRM is a server calling another server, not a person in a browser).
  6. Access → Service Auth → Service Tokens → create one. Copy its Client ID and Client Secret into the two fields below.
  7. Set AI Base URL above to https://ai.yourdomain.com, save this form, then use Test AI Connection.
